name: Cailleach Bheur

attributes.attribute: the personification of winter in Scottish Gaelic folklore
a blue-faced hag who is a daughter of the pale winter sun

text: Cailleach Bheur is Scottish Gaelic for the genteel old lady or hag. She stands as the personification of winter in Scottish folklore. She mirrors the Manx hag they call the Caillagh ny Gueshag. Her face is blue, and folk name her a child of the pale winter sun. She rules from the first of November to the first of May. Winter births her old and plain of face. When spring arrives she ends young and beautiful. That cycle mirrors the ever-renewing Cailleach Bhéirre. She also echoes the change of the Cailleach Beinne Bric. People of Ulster know her as Cally Berry. Her watery form carries the name Mwleartach.

okr.objective: Document the winter hag Cailleach Bheur and her renewal cycle.
key_results: Grounded Gaelic for the genteel old lady or hag
Set her rule from November to May with her blue face
Show her rebirth and her Ulster and watery forms
